title: Leo and the Game
text:
Leo has a red ball. He plays with it in the park every day. His friend Mia likes to play games too. They play catch after school.

Today they play a board game. The game has cards and small blue pieces. Leo wins the game, and Mia is happy for him. Mia says, 'Let's play again tomorrow!'

questions.text: Where does Leo play with his ball?
Why does Mia want to play again tomorrow?
What kind of friends are Leo and Mia?
options: Friends who like to play together
Friends who live in different countries
Friends who do not like games

vocabulary.definition: a place with grass and trees where people go to play
a round object you can throw and catch

paragraph_translations: Leo tiene una pelota roja. Juega con ella en el parque todos los días. A su amiga Mia también le gusta jugar. Juegan a la pelota después de la escuela.
Hoy juegan a un juego de mesa. El juego tiene cartas y piezas pequeñas de color azul. Leo gana el juego, y Mia está contenta por él. Mia dice: '¡Juguemos otra vez mañana!'
